findings.note_strees: No literal STREES.QH exists in the supplied original game. All STR*.QH strategy layout/help files are included.
findings.note_ls: No *.LS files exist in the supplied original game archives. The 57 *.LST unit-info image lists are included.
findings.note_lz_position: LZ/LZ0 does not carry a screen x/y placement field; screen placement is therefore null unless supplied by an external layout source. Exact compressed/decompressed byte sizes are catalogued for every LZ asset.
